04 / Portrait experiment

Softbarriers

One face, one translucent surface, and a study of what appears when clarity is interrupted.

Surface / expression

A portrait does not have to explain a person. It can hold a question.

Made as a compact visual experiment in black and white. The material softens, distorts and occasionally reveals.

“Sometimes a portrait becomes more direct when something stands between us.”
